1.0.0
=============
* Solution Architecture:
    * [#171572](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/171572) -- Cart Out of Stock Suggestions. Solution Architecture

* New features:
    * [#171571](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/171571) -- GENERAL SETTINGS. As an admin, I want to be able to specify the following parameters for the extension (see description)
    * [#176870](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/176870) -- LINK TEXT. As an admin, I want to be able to configure the text of the link for the cart page
    * [#171573](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/171573) -- FRONTEND PAGE. As a user, I want to see related products for out of stock products on cart, so that I'm able to buy smth instead of out of stock product
